sentences.text:
Applicant :- Sitaram
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secrett. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Yogeshwar Sharan Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Yogeshwar Saran Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, and Sri Jayant Singh
Tomar, learned Addl.
Government Advocate-I.

2. By means of the instant application, the applicant Sitaram S/o Ram Murat seeks bail in Sessions
Trial No. 190 of 2019 arising out of Case Crime No. 78 of 2019, under sections 498A, 304B Ipc,
alternative section 302, I.P.C. and section 3/4, Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Chhapia, District Gonda.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a first information report (F.I.R.) lodged on 16.3.2019 against the applicant, his father, mother and brother, stating that the applicant got married on 26.4.2012 with Sharda Devi, sister of the informant.

The accused persons were not satisfied with the dowry given in marriage and they used to Harass Sharda Devi for pressing the demand of additional dowry and they turned her out of her matrimonial home.
Father of the informant died on 15.5.2016 and the accused persons had gone to attend his last rights.

On that occasion the applicant's father entered into a settlement persuading the informant and his family members that the informant's sister will not be harassed and thereafter she was sent with him.
The FIR further states that the applicant and his father kept on going abroad on 14th of March 2019 at about 2:30 p.m.
The applicant made a phone-call from Dubai and told that the informant's sister had died.

sentences.text: The postmortem examination report of the deceased mentions a solitary injury on her body, i.e., a ligature mark around her neck.
5. Initially the Police had exonerated the applicant and his father, as they were not present in the country at the time of the incident.

During trial statement of the informant has been recorded as P.W.-1 and after his statement the Trial Court has passed an order dated 14.3.2022 summoning the applicant and his father under section 319, CrPC to face the trial.

6. A perusal of the statement of P.W.- 1 indicates that she has merely reiterated the F.I.R. verson and it has not been denied that the applicant was not present in the country at the time of the incident.

7. The applicant's father/co- accused Ram Murat has filed Criminal Revision No. 274 of 2022 against the summoning order and by means of an order dated 31.10.2022 a Coordinate Bench of this court has stayed further proceedings of the trial, so far as the said co-accused is concerned.
8. The applicant's mother/ co-accused Smt. Malti Devi has already been granted bail by means of order dated 14.11.2019 passed by this court in Bail application No. 7418 of 2019.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant got married to the deceased on 26.4.2012 and she died on 14.3.2019; that the applicant was not present in the country at the time of the incident and he had given information of the death of the deceased to the informant; that besides a ligature mark around her neck no other injury was found on the dead body of the deceased; the applicant's mother has already been granted bail and the proceedings in respect of the applicant's father/co-accused Ram Murat Gupta who has also been summoned along with the applicant under section 319 CrPC, have already been stayed,
coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 24th of January 2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the accused-applicant on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

11. Let the applicant Sitaram S/o Ram Murat be released on bail in the aforesaid 139 of 2021, under section 78 of 2019, under sections 498A, 304B IPC, alternative section 302, I.P.C. and section 3/4,
Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S. Chhapia, District Gonda, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.

2 11.In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
